name: Customer Preference Registration Facility, free and 24x7 (r. 6)

attrs.quote: to provide following modes, free of cost, to the customer, as per his choice, to register, modify or de register preference(s)
attrs.note: Modes: SMS or call to 1909, IVRS, USSD, an approved mobile app, a web portal with OTP. Preferences cover categories of content, modes, time bands and day types.
